# Wikipedia

> > Wikipedia is the free online encyclopedia that anyone can edit, maintained by the Wikimedia Foundation and a global community of volunteers.

Founded by Jimmy Wales and Larry Sanger, Wikipedia has grown into the world's largest collaborative knowledge resource. The English Wikipedia is the largest language edition, featuring millions of articles on topics ranging from history and science to culture and current events.

## Key Topics

- Wikipedia
- Wikimedia Foundation
- Jimmy Wales
- Larry Sanger

- [Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Main_Page): Wikipedia homepage with featured articles and daily content
- [Wikipedia - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia): Main article about Wikipedia by Wikimedia Foundation, Wales & Sanger
- [Wikipedia:About - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:About): About page explaining Wikipedia's collaborative encyclopedia mission
- [English Wikipedia - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/English_Wikipedia): Article about English Wikipedia edition and community
- [History of Wikipedia - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/History_of_Wikipedia): Historical overview of Wikipedia's development from Nupedia
